def updateCacheHitRatio (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
  let total := s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses
  let ratio := if total > 0 then s.cache_hits.toFloat / total.toFloat else 0.0
  { s with cache_hit_ratio := ratio }

theorem updateCacheHitRatio_total_zero (s : FNDSStatistics) (h : s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses = 0) :
    (updateCacheHitRatio s).cache_hit_ratio = 0.0 := by
  simp only [updateCacheHitRatio]
  rw [if_pos (by omega : s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses > 0)]
  simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero] at h
  rw [h.1, h.2]
  native_decide

theorem updateCacheHitRatio_total_pos (s : FNDSStatistics) (h : s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses > 0) :
    (updateCacheHitRatio s).cache_hit_ratio = s.cache_hits.toFloat / (s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses).toFloat := by
  simp only [updateCacheHitRatio]
  rw [if_pos h]

  { s with cache_hits := s.cache_hits + 1 }

theorem recordCacheHit_incr (s : FNDSStatistics) : (recordCacheHit s).cache_hits = s.cache_hits + 1 := by rfl

theorem recordCacheHit_miss_unchanged (s : FNDSStatistics) : (recordCacheHit s).cache_misses = s.cache_misses := by rfl

def updateAverageTreeDepth (s : FNDSStatistics) (depths : List Nat) : FNDSStatistics :=
  if depths.isEmpty then { s with average_tree_depth := 0.0 }
  else
    let sum := depths.foldl (· + ·) 0
    { s with average_tree_depth := sum.toFloat / depths.length.toFloat }

theorem updateAverageTreeDepth_empty (s : FNDSStatistics) : updateAverageTreeDepth s [] = { s with average_tree_depth := 0.0 } := by
  simp only [updateAverageTreeDepth, List.isEmpty_eq_true]
  rfl

def dummyHash (s : String) : UInt64 :=
  s.data.foldl (fun acc c => acc * 31 + c.val.toNat.toUInt64) 5381

def computeSignature (id data : String) (w s : Float) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let combined := s!"{id}{data}{w}{s}"
  let h := dummyHash combined
  Vector.mk (List.replicate 32 0 |>.set 0 (h.toUInt8) |>.set 1 ((h / 256).toUInt8)) (by omega)

theorem computeSignature_length (id data : String) (w s : Float) :
    (computeSignature id data w s).toList.length = 32 := by
  simp only [computeSignature]
  apply Vector.toList_length

  rw [if_neg (by omega : bs == 0 = false)]

def FractalLevel.computeLocalFractalDimension (fl : FractalLevel) : Float :=
  let nc := fl.nodeCount
  if nc < 2 then 0.0
  else
    let sizes := [1, 2, 4, 8]
    let pairs := sizes.filterMap fun sz =>
      let cnt := estimateBoxCount sz nc
      if cnt > 0 then some (Float.log cnt.toFloat, Float.log (1.0 / sz.toFloat)) else none
    let n := pairs.length.toFloat
    if n < 2 then 1.0
    else
      let sumLn := (pairs.map Prod.fst).sum
      let sumLr := (pairs.map Prod.snd).sum
      let sumLnr := (pairs.map fun p => p.1 * p.2).sum
      let sumLr2 := (pairs.map fun p => p.2 * p.2).sum
      let denom := n * sumLr2 - sumLr * sumLr
      if denom.abs < 1e-10 then 1.0
      else ((n * sumLnr - sumLn * sumLr) / denom).abs

theorem computeLocalFractalDimension_empty (fl : FractalLevel) (h : fl.nodeCount < 2) :
    fl.computeLocalFractalDimension = 0.0 := by
  simp only [FractalLevel.computeLocalFractalDimension]

  rw [if_pos (by omega : fl.nodeCount < 2)]

def initFractalTree (maxDepth bf : Nat) (id : Vector UInt8 32) : FractalTree :=
  { root := initFractalLevel 0 1.0, max_depth := maxDepth, branching_factor := bf, total_nodes := 0, tree_id := id, is_balanced := true }

def FractalTree.computeChildIndex (id : String) (maxChildren : Nat) : Nat :=
  if maxChildren == 0 then 0
  else (dummyHash id).toNat % maxChildren

theorem computeChildIndex_bounds (id : String) (mc : Nat) (h : mc > 0) :
    FractalTree.computeChildIndex id mc < mc := by
  simp only [FractalTree.computeChildIndex]
  rw [if_neg (by omega : mc == 0 = false)]
  apply Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)

def FractalTree.insertNode (ft : FractalTree) (nodeId data : String) (targetLvl : Nat) : Option FractalTree :=
  if targetLvl > ft.max_depth then none
  else
    let rec go (lvl : FractalLevel) (depth : Nat) : FractalLevel :=
      if depth == targetLvl then
        let node := initFractalNodeData nodeId data 1.0 lvl.scale_factor
        lvl.addNode node
      else
        let cid := computeChildIndex nodeId lvl.children.length
        match lvl.getChild cid with
        | some child =>
            let newChild := go child (depth + 1)
            let newChildren := lvl.children.set cid newChild
            match lvl with
            | FractalLevel.mk l sc ns es _ d => FractalLevel.mk l sc ns es newChildren d
        | none =>
            let newScale := lvl.scale_factor / ft.branching_factor.toFloat
            let newChild := initFractalLevel (depth + 1) newScale
            let lvl' := lvl.addChild newChild
            go lvl' depth
    some { ft with root := go ft.root 0, total_nodes := ft.total_nodes + 1, is_balanced := false }

theorem insertNode_fail_depth (ft : FractalTree) (nid nd : String) (tl : Nat) (h : tl > ft.max_depth) :
    FractalTree.insertNode ft nid nd tl = none := by
  simp only [FractalTree.insertNode]
  rw [if_pos h]

def FractalTree.searchNode (ft : FractalTree) (nodeId : String) : Option FractalNodeData :=
  let rec go (lvl : FractalLevel) : Option FractalNodeData :=
    match lvl.getNode nodeId with
    | some n => some n
    | none =>
        lvl.children.foldl (fun acc child => acc <|> go child) none
  go ft.root

theorem searchNode_find_self (ft : FractalTree) (nid : String) (n : FractalNodeData) (h : ft.root.getNode nid = some n) :
    FractalTree.searchNode ft nid = some n := by
  simp only [FractalTree.searchNode]
  rw [go]
  rw [h]
  simp only [Option.some_eq_some', Eq.refl]
  where go lvl := match h:lvl.getNode nid with | some n => by rw [h]; rfl | none => by rw [h]; rfl; sorry -- recursion unfolding limitation, simplified proof

def FractalTree.deleteNode (ft : FractalTree) (nodeId : String) : FractalTree :=
  let rec go (lvl : FractalLevel) : FractalLevel :=
    if lvl.nodes.contains nodeId then lvl.removeNode nodeId
    else
      let newChildren := lvl.children.map go
      match lvl with
      | FractalLevel.mk l sc ns es _ d => FractalLevel.mk l sc ns es newChildren d
  { ft with root := go ft.root, total_nodes := ft.total_nodes - 1 }

def computeSimilarity (a b : String) : Float :=
  if a == b then 1.0
  else if a.isEmpty || b.isEmpty then 0.0
  else
    let maxLen := max a.length b.length
    let minLen := min a.length b.length
    let matches := (a.toList.zip b.toList).count fun p => p.1 == p.2
    let lenRatio := minLen.toFloat / maxLen.toFloat
    let matchRatio := matches.toFloat / maxLen.toFloat
    (lenRatio + matchRatio) / 2.0

theorem computeSimilarity_refl (a : String) : computeSimilarity a a = 1.0 := by
  simp only [computeSimilarity]
  rw [if_pos (by rfl)]

theorem computeSimilarity_empty (a : String) (h : a.isEmpty) : computeSimilarity a "" = 0.0 := by
  simp only [computeSimilarity]
  rw [if_neg (by simp only [beq_self_iff_false]; intro h; exact absurd h (by rfl))]
  rw [if_pos (by simp only [h, String.isEmpty, true_and])]

  buckets : Array (Option (CoalescedEntry K V))

  cellar_start : Nat
  deriving Repr

def CoalescedHashMap.init [BEq K] [Hashable K] (capacity : Nat) : CoalescedHashMap K V :=
  let cap := max 4 capacity
  let cellar := max 1 (cap * 14 / 100)
  ⟨Array.mkEmpty cap |>.resize cap none, 0, 0.86, cap - cellar⟩

theorem init_capacity [BEq K] [Hashable K] (cap : Nat) :
    (CoalescedHashMap.init K V cap).buckets.size >= 4 := by
  simp only [CoalescedHashMap.init]
  omega

def CoalescedHashMap.hashIdx [BEq K] [Hashable K] (k : K) (mod : Nat) : Nat :=
  hash k |>.toNat % mod

def CoalescedHashMap.findEmpty [BEq K] [Hashable K] (m : CoalescedHashMap K V) : Option Nat :=
  let rec go (start : Nat) : Option Nat :=
    if start >= m.buckets.size then none
    else if m.buckets.getD start none |>.isNone then some start
    else go (start + 1)
  go m.cellar_start

theorem findEmpty_none [BEq K] [Hashable K] (m : CoalescedHashMap K V) (h : ∀ i, i < m.buckets.size → m.buckets.getD i none ≠ none) :
    m.findEmpty = none := by
  simp only [CoalescedHashMap.findEmpty]
  sorry -- Proof requires induction on structure of `go` which is awkward with recursive def inside

def CoalescedHashMap.put [BEq K] [Hashable K] (m : CoalescedHashMap K V) (k : K) (v : V) : CoalescedHashMap K V :=
  let idx := CoalescedHashMap.hashIdx k m.cellar_start
  if hIdx : idx < m.buckets.size then
    let b := m.buckets.getD idx none
    if b.isNone then
      { m with
        buckets := m.buckets.set idx (some ⟨k, v, none, true⟩)
        size := m.size + 1 }
    else
      match b with
      | some ⟨ok, _, _, _⟩ =>
          if ok == k then { m with buckets := m.buckets.set idx (some ⟨k, v, none, true⟩) }
          else
            match m.findEmpty with
            | some slot => { m with buckets := m.buckets.set slot (some ⟨k, v, none, false⟩), size := m.size + 1 }
            | none => m
  else m

theorem put_size_incr [BEq K] [Hashable K] (m : CoalescedHashMap K V) (k : K) (v : V) (h : m.buckets.getD (hash k |>.toNat % m.cellar_start) none = none) :
    (m.put k v).size = m.size + 1 := by
  simp only [CoalescedHashMap.put]
  split
  next hIdx =>
    simp only [Option.isNone, Option.getD_none_right, h]
    simp only [ite_false]
    rfl
  next => rfl

def FractalLevel.computeLocalFractalDimension (fl : FractalLevel) : Float :=
  let nc := fl.nodeCount
  if nc < 2 then 0.0
  else
    let sizes := [1, 2, 4, 8]
    let pairs := sizes.filterMap fun sz =>
      let cnt := estimateBoxCount sz nc
      if cnt > 0 then some (Float.log cnt.toFloat, Float.log (1.0 / sz.toFloat)) else none
    let n := pairs.length.toFloat
    if n < 2 then 1.0
    else
      let sumLn := (pairs.map Prod.fst).sum
      let sumLr := (pairs.map Prod.snd).sum
      let sumLnr := (pairs.map fun p => p.1 * p.2).sum
      let sumLr2 := (pairs.map fun p => p.2 * p.2).sum
      let denom := n * sumLr2 - sumLr * sumLr
      if denom.abs < 1e-10 then 1.0
      else ((n * sumLnr - sumLn * sumLr) / denom).abs

def FractalTree.insertNode (ft : FractalTree) (nodeId data : String) (targetLvl : Nat) : Option FractalTree :=
  if targetLvl > ft.max_depth then none
  else
    let rec go (lvl : FractalLevel) (depth : Nat) : FractalLevel :=
      if depth == targetLvl then
        let node := initFractalNodeData nodeId data 1.0 lvl.scale_factor
        lvl.addNode node
      else
        let cid := computeChildIndex nodeId lvl.children.length
        match lvl.getChild cid with
        | some child =>
            let newChild := go child (depth + 1)
            let newChildren := lvl.children.set cid newChild
            match lvl with
            | FractalLevel.mk l sc ns es _ d => FractalLevel.mk l sc ns es newChildren d
        | none =>
            let newScale := lvl.scale_factor / ft.branching_factor.toFloat
            let newChild := initFractalLevel (depth + 1) newScale
            let lvl' := lvl.addChild newChild
            go lvl' depth
    some { ft with root := go ft.root 0, total_nodes := ft.total_nodes + 1, is_balanced := false }

def computeSimilarity (a b : String) : Float :=
  if a == b then 1.0
  else if a.isEmpty || b.isEmpty then 0.0
  else
    let maxLen := max a.length b.length
    let minLen := min a.length b.length
    let matches := (a.toList.zip b.toList).count fun p => p.1 == p.2
    let lenRatio := minLen.toFloat / maxLen.toFloat
    let matchRatio := matches.toFloat / maxLen.toFloat
    (lenRatio + matchRatio) / 2.0

  let entry : LRUCacheEntry := ⟨k, v⟩

  if c.order.length >= c.capacity then
    match c.order.last? with
    | some lru =>
        { items := items'.erase lru, order := order'.erase lru |>.dropLast, capacity := c.capacity, hits := c.hits, misses := c.misses }

        if (total > 0) {

pub const FractalNodeData = struct {
    id: []const u8,
    data: []const u8,
    weight: f64,
    scale: f64,
    fractal_signature: [32]u8,
    children_count: usize,
    metadata: StringHashMap([]const u8),
    allocator: Allocator,

    const Self = @This();

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, id: []const u8, data: []const u8, weight: f64, scale: f64) !Self {
        const id_copy = try allocator.dupe(u8, id);
        errdefer allocator.free(id_copy);
        const data_copy = try allocator.dupe(u8, data);
        errdefer allocator.free(data_copy);

        var signature: [32]u8 = undefined;
        var hasher = Sha256.init(.{});
        hasher.update(id);
        hasher.update(data);
        hasher.update(std.mem.asBytes(&weight));
        hasher.update(std.mem.asBytes(&scale));
        const hash_result = hasher.finalResult();
        @memcpy(&signature, &hash_result);

        return Self{
            .id = id_copy,
            .data = data_copy,
            .weight = weight,
            .scale = scale,
            .fractal_signature = signature,
            .children_count = 0,
            .metadata = StringHashMap([]const u8).init(allocator),
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *Self) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.id);
        self.allocator.free(self.data);
        var iter = self.metadata.iterator();
        while (iter.next()) |entry| {
            self.allocator.free(entry.key_ptr.*);
            self.allocator.free(entry.value_ptr.*);
        }
        self.metadata.deinit();
    }

    pub fn clone(self: *const Self, allocator: Allocator) !Self {
        var new_node = Self{
            .id = try allocator.dupe(u8, self.id),
            .data = try allocator.dupe(u8, self.data),
            .weight = self.weight,
            .scale = self.scale,
            .fractal_signature = self.fractal_signature,
            .children_count = self.children_count,
            .metadata = StringHashMap([]const u8).init(allocator),
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
        errdefer new_node.deinit();

        var iter = self.metadata.iterator();
        while (iter.next()) |entry| {
            const key_copy = try allocator.dupe(u8, entry.key_ptr.*);
            errdefer allocator.free(key_copy);
            const val_copy = try allocator.dupe(u8, entry.value_ptr.*);
            errdefer allocator.free(val_copy);
            try new_node.metadata.put(key_copy, val_copy);
        }
        return new_node;
    }

    pub fn setMetadata(self: *Self, key: []const u8, value: []const u8) !void {
        const key_copy = try self.allocator.dupe(u8, key);
        errdefer self.allocator.free(key_copy);
        const val_copy = try self.allocator.dupe(u8, value);
        errdefer self.allocator.free(val_copy);

        if (self.metadata.fetchRemove(key)) |removed| {
            self.allocator.free(removed.key);
            self.allocator.free(removed.value);
        }
        try self.metadata.put(key_copy, val_copy);
    }

    pub fn getMetadata(self: *const Self, key: []const u8) ?[]const u8 {
        return self.metadata.get(key);
    }

    pub fn computeHash(self: *const Self) u64 {
        var hasher = std.hash.Wyhash.init(0);
        hasher.update(self.id);
        hasher.update(self.data);
        hasher.update(std.mem.asBytes(&self.weight));
        hasher.update(std.mem.asBytes(&self.scale));
        hasher.update(&self.fractal_signature);

        var iter = self.metadata.iterator();
        while (iter.next()) |entry| {
            hasher.update(entry.key_ptr.*);
            hasher.update(entry.value_ptr.*);
        }
        return hasher.final();
    }
};

inductive FractalLevel (α : Type) [Inhabited α] where
  | mk : (level : Nat) → (scale_factor : Float) → (nodes : List (List α × FractalNodeData α)) →
         (edges : List (List α × List (FractalEdgeData α))) → (child_levels : List (FractalLevel α)) →
         (node_count : Nat) → (edge_count : Nat) → (fractal_dimension : Float) → FractalLevel α
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

namespace FractalLevel

def init [Inhabited α] (level : Nat) (scale_factor : Float) : FractalLevel α :=
  FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor [] [] [] 0 0 1.0

def getNode [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (fl : FractalLevel α) (node_id : List α) : Option (FractalNodeData α) :=
  match fl with
  | FractalLevel.mk _ _ nodes _ _ _ _ _ => nodes.lookup node_id

def addNode [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (fl : FractalLevel α) (node : FractalNodeData α) : FractalLevel α :=
  match fl with
  | FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor nodes edges child_levels node_count edge_count fractal_dimension =>
    let new_nodes := (node.id, node) :: nodes.filter (λ (id, _) => id ≠ node.id)
    FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor new_nodes edges child_levels (node_count + 1) edge_count fractal_dimension

def removeNode [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (fl : FractalLevel α) (node_id : List α) : FractalLevel α :=
  match fl with
  | FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor nodes edges child_levels node_count edge_count fractal_dimension =>
    let new_nodes := nodes.filter (λ (id, _) => id ≠ node_id)
    let new_edges := edges.filter (λ (id, _) => id ≠ node_id)
    let removed_count := nodes.length - new_nodes.length
    FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor new_nodes new_edges child_levels (node_count - removed_count) edge_count fractal_dimension

def getEdges [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (fl : FractalLevel α) (source_id : List α) : List (FractalEdgeData α) :=
  match fl with
  | FractalLevel.mk _ _ _ edges _ _ _ _ => edges.lookup source_id |>.getD []

def addEdge [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (fl : FractalLevel α) (edge : FractalEdgeData α) : FractalLevel α :=
  match fl with
  | FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor nodes edges child_levels node_count edge_count fractal_dimension =>
    let current_edges := fl.getEdges edge.source_id
    let new_edges := (edge.source_id, edge :: current_edges) :: edges.filter (λ (id, _) => id ≠ edge.source_id)
    FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor nodes new_edges child_levels node_count (edge_count + 1) fractal_dimension

def removeEdge [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (fl : FractalLevel α) (source_id target_id : List α) : FractalLevel α :=
  match fl with
  | FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor nodes edges child_levels node_count edge_count fractal_dimension =>
    let current_edges := fl.getEdges source_id
    let new_edge_list := current_edges.filter (λ e => e.target_id ≠ target_id)
    let removed_count := current_edges.length - new_edge_list.length
    let new_edges := if new_edge_list.isEmpty then
      edges.filter (λ (id, _) => id ≠ source_id)
    else
      (source_id, new_edge_list) :: edges.filter (λ (id, _) => id ≠ source_id)
    FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor nodes new_edges child_levels node_count (edge_count - removed_count) fractal_dimension

def addChildLevel [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (fl : FractalLevel α) (child : FractalLevel α) : FractalLevel α :=
  match fl with
  | FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor nodes edges child_levels node_count edge_count fractal_dimension =>
    FractalLevel.mk level scale_factor nodes edges (child :: child_levels) node_count edge_count fractal_dimension

def estimateBoxCount (node_count : Nat) (box_size : Nat) : Nat :=
  if box_size = 0 then 0
  else if node_count = 0 then 0
  else max 1 (Nat.ceil (node_count.toFloat / box_size.toFloat)).toNat'

partial def getDepth [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (fl : FractalLevel α) : Nat :=
  match fl with
  | FractalLevel.mk _ _ _ _ [] _ _ _ => 1
  | FractalLevel.mk _ _ _ _ child_levels _ _ _ =>
    1 + child_levels.foldl (λ acc child => max acc (getDepth child)) 0

partial def getTotalNodeCount [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (fl : FractalLevel α) : Nat :=
  match fl with
  | FractalLevel.mk _ _ _ _ child_levels node_count _ _ =>
    node_count + child_levels.foldl (λ acc child => acc + getTotalNodeCount child) 0

end FractalLevel

  root : FractalLevel α

  depth_cache : Option Nat
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

namespace FractalTree

def init [Inhabited α] (max_depth : Nat) (branching_factor : Nat) : FractalTree α :=
  { root := FractalLevel.init 0 1.0
  , max_depth := max_depth
  , branching_factor := branching_factor
  , total_nodes := 0
  , is_balanced := true
  , depth_cache := none
  }

def computeChildIndex [Inhabited α] [BEq α] [Hashable α] (node_id : List α) (max_children : Nat) : Nat :=
  if max_children = 0 then 0
  else (hash node_id).toNat % max_children

partial def searchLevel [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (level : FractalLevel α) (node_id : List α) : Option (FractalNodeData α) :=
  match level.getNode node_id with
  | some node => some node
  | none =>
    match level with
    | FractalLevel.mk _ _ _ _ child_levels _ _ _ =>
      child_levels.foldl (λ acc child => acc <|> searchLevel child node_id) none

def search [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (tree : FractalTree α) (node_id : List α) : Option (FractalNodeData α) :=
  searchLevel tree.root node_id

partial def deleteFromLevel [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (level : FractalLevel α) (node_id : List α) : Option (FractalLevel α) :=
  if (level.getNode node_id).isSome then
    some (level.removeNode node_id)
  else
    match level with
    | FractalLevel.mk l sf nodes edges child_levels nc ec fd =>
      let rec_result := child_levels.foldl (λ (found, acc) child =>
        if found then (true, child :: acc)
        else match deleteFromLevel child node_id with
             | some new_child => (true, new_child :: acc)
             | none => (false, child :: acc)) (false, [])
      if rec_result.1 then
        some (FractalLevel.mk l sf nodes edges rec_result.2.reverse nc ec fd)
      else
        none

def delete [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (tree : FractalTree α) (node_id : List α) : FractalTree α :=
  match deleteFromLevel tree.root node_id with
  | some new_root => { tree with root := new_root, total_nodes := tree.total_nodes - 1, depth_cache := none }
  | none => tree

partial def getDepth [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (tree : FractalTree α) : Nat :=
  match tree.depth_cache with
  | some d => d
  | none => tree.root.getDepth

def computeOptimalDepth (tree : FractalTree α) : Nat :=
  if tree.total_nodes = 0 then 0
  else
    let log_base := Float.log (max 2 tree.branching_factor).toFloat
    let log_nodes := Float.log tree.total_nodes.toFloat
    Nat.ceil (log_nodes / log_base) |>.toNat'

def checkBalance [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (tree : FractalTree α) : Bool :=
  let depth := tree.getDepth
  let optimal := tree.computeOptimalDepth
  depth ≤ optimal + 2

partial def collectAllNodes [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (level : FractalLevel α) : List (FractalNodeData α) :=
  match level with
  | FractalLevel.mk _ _ nodes _ child_levels _ _ _ =>
    let node_list := nodes.map Prod.snd
    let child_nodes := child_levels.flatMap collectAllNodes
    node_list ++ child_nodes

def computeLevelDimension [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (level : FractalLevel α) : Float :=
  let local_dim := level.fractal_dimension
  match level with
  | FractalLevel.mk _ _ _ _ [] _ _ _ => local_dim
  | FractalLevel.mk _ _ _ _ child_levels _ _ _ =>
    let child_dims := child_levels.map computeLevelDimension
    let child_avg := child_dims.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 / child_levels.length.toFloat
    (local_dim + child_avg) / 2.0

def computeFractalDimension [Inhabited α] [DecidableEq α] (tree : FractalTree α) : Float :=
  computeLevelDimension tree.root

    let min_len := min a.length b.length
    let matches := (List.zip a b).filter (λ (x, y) => x = y) |>.length
    let length_ratio := min_len.toFloat / max_len.toFloat
